status: No remaining actionable defect found in the reviewed conditional source-event path after two corrections; native automatic-fade owner closure remains pending.

scope.operation: Read-only review of source inspection, preserved-source verification, selected-media snapshot validation, bounded RIFF PCM24 reader, Float32 conversion/event-gain kernel and atomic output publication.
scope.interpretation: Explicit reconstruction of one saved event under fresh normal source restoration, zero-origin source coordinates, matching source/output rate, full successful reads, supported no-processing state and explicit Float32 output. This is not ordinary project transport or hosted Cubase output.
fresh_state_conditions: No callback or later mutation changing the reconstructed event, its selected stream or effective settings.
No external runtime pitch-analysis/context state. The child-class gate excludes unsupported serialized pitch children; it does not observe or prove runtime packed pitch flags.
Source-effective automatic-fade flags must be explicitly zero under the separately verified owner relationship.
excluded: Whole-track/mixer/automation/routing/plugin processing, overlap selection, arbitrary host state and runtime callbacks.
General fades, warp/pitch/loop/replacement layers, rate conversion, general source formats, partial reads and cancellation.
Actual Cubase runtime PCM comparison or sample-resampler fidelity.
scope.reviewer_authorship_note: CPRAutoFadeArchive.swift is included as dependency context. The reviewer authored that decoder, so this record does not characterize its internal implementation as independently authored/reviewed evidence.

fixed_findings.problem: The plan initially accepted arbitrary opaque clip children while the no-processing selector contract requires unsupported serialized pitch state to be absent. CPRAudioEventArchive intentionally preserves child descriptors without interpreting their processing.
fixed_findings.correction: Every accepted clip child must now have class MHitPointEvent, version 3 and payloadByteCount 26. Other classes, versions and extents remain unsupported. The external/no-pitch call-time assumption stays explicit.
fixed_findings.evidence: Renderer-selection R5/R6 and original LoFi child records; peer native reviewer confirmed 214 MHitPointEvent v3 children of 26-byte payloads.
fixed_findings.regression_source: ForwardSourcePlanRejectsEnabledFadesWarpAndInversion includes a same-size unknown child-class declaration mutation and requires rejection.

fixed_findings.problem: The original guard evaluated Int16 channels * 3 before rejecting channels outside 1...2. Frozen V4 intentionally retains unusual source metadata, so a source channels value 32767 could reach inspection and trap instead of failing closed.
fixed_findings.correction: The 1...2 range check now precedes frame-size arithmetic, and multiplication is widened to Int.
fixed_findings.regression_source: ForwardSourcePlanRejectsEnabledFadesWarpAndInversion mutates the source AudioFile channels field at payloadOffset+12 to 0x7fff and requires rejection.

verified_code_properties: ProjectStore.verifiedCPRSourceEvent validates the in-memory project, replays the frozen compatibility baseline, then reads original CPR bytes and checks their digest plus event/clip/cluster identities. Retained events remain bound to their original imported track.
Public rendering validates the selected attachment metadata, resolves contained media, reads a bounded byte snapshot and verifies its recorded SHA256 before decoding or publishing output.

RIFF length, chunk bounds including padding, unique fmt/data chunks, accepted format lengths, PCM tag, exact channel/rate/frame-byte layout and data frame count are checked before indexed sample access.
Frame/channel bounds keep the reachable sample count and RIFF output byte counts within checked implementation limits.

The C kernel decodes signed little-endian 24-bit samples exactly to Float32, then uses a separate Float32 gain multiply for nonunity gain. It rejects non-nearest rounding and gains outside its normal-or-zero arithmetic domain before writing output.

The plan gain floor now matches the kernel floor Float.leastNormalMagnitude * 8388608. The greatest finite positive Float gain cannot overflow when multiplied by a PCM24 sample whose absolute value is at most one.
The complete input and output are validated/constructed before Data.write with atomic publication. Failures before publication leave an existing destination untouched.

Source-project output containment is rejected; the operation does not modify the frozen report/original source or promote the unresolved source event into a playable Clip. Ordinary project playback/export refusal remains separate.

remaining_caveats.observation: CPRSourceAudioInspection returns localRenderUnavailableReason=nil whenever the source plan succeeds and an attachment row exists. It does not at that point read/hash the attached file or establish that its container is accepted PCM24 RIFF.
remaining_caveats.example: A previously attached file that later goes missing/changes, or a matching PCM24 AIFF accepted by the general attachment API, can appear ready until rendering is attempted.
remaining_caveats.safety_behavior: Rendering still validates the actual byte snapshot/hash and rejects unsupported WAV structure before atomic publication. No output-integrity failure was found.
remaining_caveats.suggestion: A later readiness preflight may reuse actual-media/container checks or distinguish source-state eligibility from current media readiness; do not weaken the rendering checks.
